message:
The Mom-stuff would definitely add a layer to it.  I know that you've written before about your grief in ways that seems that it's still very fresh and hard for you, but it must still be great to call on all of the positive influential ways that she had on your life.  It must be great to have had a mother who was such an educational inspiration. Someone who "knew stuff" and you just sorta knew she knew it.

I love Driving and Crying, too. :)
